main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x excess 3-bar return over Sunday cases
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, with at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return, larger-fall half minus smaller-fall half (median forecast split)

decided_by: Confirm rule: t of 2 or more with at least 100 cases, and the larger-fall half's mean excess return exceeds the smaller-fall half's.
reading: Sunday bars are those whose UTC start is a Sunday; cases need forecast >= 2 and close[t+3] in the same window; the coin's mean 3-bar return uses the non-overlapping grid 0,3,6,... of each window pooled across windows; the larger-fall half is forecast strictly above the median and the smaller-fall half the rest.
